page.overview:
What is Knights' Kingdom?

Knights' Kingdom is a short-lived subtheme of Castle released in 2000. It was centered on the conflict between King Leo's kingdom and Cedric the Bull's bandits.

A second theme also titled Knights' Kingdom was released in 2004, but there was no contemporary connection between these two sub-themes other than the medieval setting and the conflict between good and evil. However, the 2006 set 10176 Royal King's Castle features the 2000 theme's crests, and the Evil Knight's biography retroactively establishes a canonical link in their storylines.

The Knights' Kingdom line of 2000 signaled a return to a more traditional interpretation of European-style castles after the end of the oriental-themed . On the online LEGO Shop, Knights' Kingdom was included under the banner of Castle, confirming it as an official subtheme. However, unlike prior Castle subthemes from 1987-1997, Knights Kingdom lacks any explicit connections with other Castle factions in sets and storyline, although there are some references in tie-in media such as 5730 LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge. The Knights were led by King Leo, who were pitted against an army of bandits commanded by Cedric the Bull. King Leo's side was housed in his own castle, while the Bulls lived in the Dark Forest. However it is unknown and unclear whether this forest is the exact same forest as the one from the subtheme of the same name.

This was the first Castle theme that featured a complete royal family with King Leo, his wife, Queen Leonora and his daughter, Princess Storm, who wanted to be a knight. King Leo's castle and grounds were decorated with new carved lion head bricks and ornate stained glass window pieces, while Cedric's fearsome battle machines were equipped with spring-loaded projectile launchers. King Leo and Queen Leonora have a son named Edward, who, in the book Medieval Mischief and Mayhem, was fighting in the crusades.
